item.title: Tom Holland and Zendaya share another box-office hit as 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' makes history on the heels of 'The Odyssey'
item.description: The Sony superhero film achieved the second-largest North American opening ever, earning $355 million in ticket sales.

item.title: Sen. Bernie Moreno says Rep. Max Miller shouldn't serve in the House, calling former son-in-law a 'danger to my daughter' and granddaughter
item.description: Emily Moreno has accused Miller of scalding, hitting, and threatening her during their marriage. Miller has denied these allegations.

item.title: As Trump balks again at escalating war, Iran smells 'blood in the water' and looks to exploit its newfound strategic advantage, experts say
item.description: Analysts note that recent events highlight Iran's apparent strategic advantage, which it may seek to leverage further.

item.title: Wall Street's favored trade unravels as chip stocks cause market swings
item.description: The SOX semiconductor index fell 21% in July, its worst month since October 2008.
